author: TerryWang
subsetRanges: U+2000-206F, U+3000-303F, U+3400-9FFF, U+FF00-FFEF (characters used on the site)
repairs: 14 simplified code points carried traditional/Japanese components (认让讲论证 钟钥钻 辆辐辑输 练继). They are rebuilt from the font's own correct radicals (计 针 轨 红) and their own right-hand components (练 uses 炼's 东) with skia-pathops; see scripts/patch-huiwen-mincho.py.
